In 2000, Charles Best, a teacher at a Bronx public high school, thought about all the money he and his colleagues were spending on books, art supplies, and other materials for their students. They weren't alone — today, teachers still spend an average of over $600 out of pocket on their classrooms each year. Charles figured there were people who'd want to help if they could see where their money was going. He founded DonorsChoose, a website where teachers could post requests for classroom resources, and his colleagues posted the first 11 projects. Since then, teachers at most US public schools have requested resources through our platform. Our team Our team has vetted and fulfilled over 2 million classroom project requests that range from butterfly cocoons, to robotics kits, to books with diverse characters. Many of us are former teachers, so our operation feels like a cross between a tech company and a classroom. Whether we're in our NYC office or working remotely across the country, you'll find us digging into our data, sharing our favorite projects, and Instagramming teacher and student joy. Meet the team How it works To ensure integrity, we're there through every step of every project. We vet all requests, purchase each item, and ship materials directly to verified teachers. We've mobilized 1,902,345 citizen donors and dozens of generous corporate and foundation partners. Together, they've given $314,212,124 to support requests from teachers. Helping to make learning more engaging at 16,212,124 schools across the country. And we won't stop until every student has what they need to succeed. Firefox Safari Google Chrome Microsoft Edge About Us Impact Team Financials Student Focus Trust & Transparency DonorsChoose was founded on the belief that people would donate to public school classrooms if they could see exactly where their money was going. From vetting every project request to sending resources instead of cash, financial transparency and accountability are core to our model. $155.67 Million Total Operating Expenses 92% Program services 2% General and administrative 6% Fundraising In the 2022–23 school year, more than $140 million directly supported America's public schools. On DonorsChoose, you choose the classroom project you want to support. You support the projects that inspire you, and our team purchases and ships the educator-requested resources directly to the classroom, propelling us towards our mission of giving every student in every community a great education. The efficiency of your donation is a top priority for our team. Program services: 92% The overwhelming majority of our expenses go toward classroom materials like books, art supplies, science equipment, and other resources for students. Program services also include postage for student thank-you letters, coordinating the delivery of materials, building deeper connections with school districts, and improving the DonorsChoose teacher experience. General and administrative: 2% We're dedicated to running a lean, teacher- and student-focused organization, which is why we keep administrative costs at just 2% of our expenses. Fundraising: 6% We believe supporting teachers and students is our nation's collective responsibility. Unlike other organizations, we generate most funding from outside teachers' personal networks of friends and family, inspiring individuals, foundations, and companies to support public schools. As a result, 83% of donations on DonorsChoose come from funders who've never met the teacher they're giving to. Highest Rating Charity Watch Highest Rating Charity Navigator Highest Rating Guidestar Behind the Project When people give to a classroom project, we suggest a 15% optional donation to DonorsChoose. Donors can reduce or remove this donation (although 84% keep it as is), while partners keep it intact. In addition to supporting our general operations, this 15% optional donation enables us to help teachers succeed. Teacher Outreach Our team works hard to introduce DonorsChoose to teachers across the country, so that educators in every classroom in America know where to turn when looking for extra classroom resources. Funding Projects from First Time Teachers Your donation to DonorsChoose allows us to set first-time teachers up for success by offering things like the Friends & Family Code, which doubles donations to first-time teacher projects for the first week. Maintaining Our Site Our Product and Engineering team works under the hood every day to keep our site best-in-class, giving teachers and donors a great experience. See Where Every Dollar Goes Every classroom project request on DonorsChoose features a line item breakdown of each requested resource, necessary processing costs, and the suggested donation to DonorsChoose. FREE Sales tax Every state has different rules regarding the tax-exempt status of nonprofits, so requested resources may still incur a sales tax despite our organization's general IRS tax exempt status. $50.39 3rd party payment processing fee This 1.5% payment processing fee represents the weighted average of fees DonorsChoose incurs across various payment methods through which donations are placed. Credit cards and PayPal donations incur a charge of about 2.5%, check donations incur nominal handling and processing charges, and large grants to fund classroom projects received via wire transfer typically do not incur fees. Because all transactions in the US must be charged the same fee regardless of payment form, we've set a standard 1.5% processing fee. $10.80 Fulfillment labor & materials DonorsChoose provides end-to-end integrity by vetting each project before posting it, purchasing and coordinating delivery of the materials, and processing thank-you letters and photos from the classroom. $30.00 Total project cost The total project cost is the sum of materials and fees listed above, and must be met to bring this project to life. $811.07 Suggested donation to help DonorsChoose reach more classrooms This 15% optional allocation, which donors can opt out of or reduce during checkout, goes towards the work we do to engaging new audiences, maintaining our site, and funding projects from first time teachers and those working in low-income communities, along with supporting our general operations. Our efficiency and transparency have earned DonorsChoose the top 4-star rating from Charity Navigator. $143.13 Total project goal The total project goal is the amount we hope to reach and includes the 15% donation to help DonorsChoose reach more classrooms. Fundraising: 6% We believe supporting teachers and students is our nation's collective responsibility. focus_sections.heading: About DonorsChoose
focus_sections.passage: DonorsChoose is the leading way to give to public schools. Since 2000, people and partners have contributed to support teacher requests for classroom resources and experiences. As the most trusted crowdfunding platform for teachers, donors, and district administrators alike, DonorsChoose vets each request, ships the funded resources directly to the classroom, and provides thank yous and reporting to donors and school leaders. Charity Navigator and GuideStar have awarded DonorsChoose, a 501(c)3 nonprofit, their highest ratings for transparency and accountability.
